_pressure_envelope.note: OAuth token-exchange response shape per Lightspeed K-Series authorization-overview docs. The adapter's oauth_refresh_cron runs at 5 min past the hour and refreshes any token whose token_expires_at < now + 24h. expires_in = 1500 seconds (25 minutes) is the documented access-token TTL — within the 24h refresh horizon, so the cron will refresh it.
